title: Aether Reliquary high-fidelity visual asset briefs
summary: Generation and artist-ready briefs for the next production batches, anchored to the approved Hero Kit quality target and rejecting flat glyph/dashboard art.
globalPromptRules: High-fidelity illustrated 2D browser RPG art, painted or rendered, with material depth.
Use the approved Hero Kit character, outfit, weapon, and armor sheets as the quality reference.
No text, no logos, no watermark, no marketplace preview frame.
No flat vector glyphs, dashboard icons, minimal symbolic cards, or placeholder token characters.
No modern firearms, no sci-fi guns, no Warhammer, no Space Marine, no Titus, no franchise-derived silhouettes.
Warm ancient techno-fantasy materials: brass, leather, ash, glass, nacre, stone, root, cloth, and ember light.
outputPolicies: Generated outputs remain draft until operator-reviewed.
Approved outputs must be normalized into fixed PNG/WebP sheets under public/arpg/illustrated/.
Every shipped output needs a prompt/provenance record and manifest entry.
If an output reads as flat UI art, mark it rejected/reference-only and do not render it as production game art.
